title: Path to $3.57 — what the market price implies (reverse DCF)
reading: At r=15%, g=10%, the $3.57 price needs retained revenue of $202,814,457/yr — 8.3x today's R₀. At the current 33.54% capture and 16.03 bps fee rate that means $377.2B of annual Intents volume (8.3x today's annualised volume), or $50,391,189 of gross fees every 30 days. Capture alone cannot get there: with volume flat, the price needs a 279% capture rate — impossible. Even at 100% capture with volume flat, the DCF ceiling is $1.28 (36% of the price). The price is a bet on volume growth, not on retention.
